title: Topic
description: One Topic (CONTEXT.md; PLAN 5 and M23; ADR 0037): the front matter of content/topics/{slug}.md, which is the whole file: nothing is written under it. A Topic is labels, a definition quoted from a cited source, and names of Series and Events. There is no field for prose of the site's own: none for an explanation, a finding, a cause or a published account. A label is a few words and is not a sentence.

slug.description: Permanent. The file is named for it and the page is /topics/{slug}.

status.description: A draft is never in a public-profile Release.

definition.title: TopicDefinition
definition.description: What the Topic's main measure is, in its origin agency's own words: quoted, never paraphrased.

quote.description: The agency's words, verbatim, as they stand at the cited address.

main.description: The Series the Topic opens with: its change strip and its main figure.

series.description: The Topic's member Series, in the order they are listed on its page. The main Series is one of them.

companions.description: What else moved (CONTEXT.md, Companion): Series an editor chose to show beside the main Series on one time axis. Each states how it is related to the main Series, as one of a closed list of factual relations. It is never said to have caused, or to explain, a movement.

range.title: TopicRange
range.description: One Series set against the range of a group: the lowest, the middle and the highest value among the group's members in each Period. The members are the Series a coverage matrix (catalog/coverage/{coverage}.json) gives for one indicator, one per country.

label.description: What the group is called on the page: 'G20'.

events.description: Events an editor lists on the Topic's page, by id. Not a statement that any of them moved a Series.

label.description: A few words. Not a sentence: no full stop, question mark, exclamation mark or line break.

relation.description: How a Companion is related to the Topic's main Series. component: it measures a part of what the main Series measures. excludes_components: it measures the same thing with some parts left out. input: the main Series is computed from it. same_survey: both come from one survey of one agency. same_release: the agency publishes both in one release.

citation.title: TopicCitation
citation.description: Where the quoted words stand: the publisher and the page, the address, and an archived copy of it or which of a closed list of reasons there is none. No field of it holds a sentence of the site's own.

name.description: The publisher and the name of the page the words stand on, as the page gives it: 'U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Consumer Price Index'. One line. A name, held to the word list like a title.

no_archive.description: Why this citation has no archived copy: one of a closed list, each with fixed words on the page. no_copy_found: the Internet Archive holds no copy of the address. archiving_refused: the publisher does not allow its pages to be archived. page_removed: the page is no longer at the address and no copy was kept.
